name: Croke
description: The Croke were a species of sentient, multi-legged beings from the planet Crakull in the Unknown Regions who were extremely long lived; one individual enjoyed a lifespan of more than 20,000 years. In their natural form, the species resembled bristly-legged snails that were diminutive enough to be held in a Human hand. However, Croke were naturally skilled in illusion casting, a Force ability that allowed them to appear in larger guises.

data.name: Croke
data.length: Small enough to fit in a Human hand; no bigger than a Wookiee's fist
